findings.claim: 10-K 自述：Vicor 在整體商用電源市場份額很小，競爭對手多為資源遠大於己的 IDM 與無晶圓廠電源半導體商；公司認為其差異化技術仍保有有利競爭位置。
findings.excerpt: Despite our minor share in the overall merchant market and the competitive presence of numerous, far larger vendors in the market segments we serve with both Advanced Products and Brick Products, we believe we maintain an advantageous competitive position in those market segments based on our differentiated technology.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：大型對手常以大幅折扣價守住份額與客戶關係，Vicor 可能無法跟進。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Larger competitors frequently seek to maintain market share and protect customer relationships through heavily-discounted pricing, which we may not be able to match.

findings.claim: SemiAnalysis 報導 Monolithic Power 在 Nvidia H100 GPU 供電上取代 Vicor（2023 文章）。
findings.source: SemiAnalysis Newsletter: Energizing AI Power Delivery Competition
findings.excerpt: However, Vicor’s fortunes have changed rapidly more recently given the dynamic nature of the power market. As we exclusively discovered and disclosed over a year ago, Monolithic Power Systems was able to supplant Vicor in Nvidia’s H100 GPU.

findings.claim: Vicor 預期 2026 下半年與一家超大規模雲商及數家 OEM 接洽，相關專案最快 2027 年 Q3/Q4 量產；Advanced Products Q2 2026 營收 $94.2M、backlog 約 $380M。
findings.source: Zacks/Chartmill: Vicor Q2 Earnings Call Highlights AI Power and Fab Push

note: 搜尋未找到可逐字引用的份額數字或具名對手設計案；MPS 取代 Vicor 於部分 Nvidia GPU 插槽、ADI 收購 Empower 為搜尋摘要轉述，未讀頁面，列為 clues。 線索 2 條，程式核實 1 條，1 條以搜尋摘要保留（未核原文）
